name: Google Classroom
summary: A classroom management and learning workflow service within Google Workspace for Education, supporting assignment distribution, feedback, communication and class organisation.

value: SIS roster sync and third-party education apps

value.from: Education Fundamentals: free for eligible institutions. Education Standard: US$3/student/year; Teaching and Learning: US$4/licence/month; Education Plus: US$5/student/year (published US pricing; local pricing may vary).
value.notes: Eligibility and feature set depend on institution type and edition. Published figures are US pricing; check local Google for Education quote and currency.
